patch.value: The daily release workflow published to npm before pushing the version bump to protected main. The push was rejected with GH006 and set -e killed the job before the tag push, leaving npm ahead of git. Port the pm-beads fix: merge release metadata through a protected PR before publishing, then push only the tag. The PM_RELEASE_APPROVED gate is preserved unchanged.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Ported the pm-beads release.yml transformation: added pull-requests:write permission, base_sha decide output, Merge release metadata through protected PR step with merge-loop, Verify merged release step, and replaced Publish+Push-tag-and-main with Publish+Push-tag-only. dist/ is gitignored and not tracked in pm-rl so it is NOT included in the verify diff list. The job-level PM_RELEASE_APPROVED gate and github.ref check are preserved unchanged. The release_iso_date decide output and --date changelog flag are preserved. No existing gate, approval condition, or if: guard was modified, weakened, or bypassed.
